transcript.text: Good morning everyone. As we head into the weekend commissioning of the new V-12 vision-inspection station, I want to make sure we're all aligned. I'll be making the final commissioning decision, but per our standard pre-work review process, I need check-ins from maintenance, quality, and safety before we approve the work order. We also still need to finalize whether the station goes at Cell 3 or Cell 7 — both are producing the same product family, so I'd like to hear any preferences or concerns from the team. And as a reminder, the station needs to complete both commissioning and validation before we can use it for any production release decisions. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share my fit-up check findings. The V-12 camera mount aligns only with Cell 7's 6 mm bracket pattern — it won't fit Cell 3. Installing at Cell 7 requires exactly 4 hours and isolation of exactly 3 electrical points. I recorded all the measurements in the weekend commissioning file, but that file is still awaiting engineering signoff and hasn't been added to the work-order summary yet, so the team may not have seen this information.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share something important from the quality side. I reviewed the customer validation appendix this morning, and release requires exactly 30 signed reference samples followed by challenge testing on exactly 100 consecutive production pieces. The quality checklist has not yet been revised because the customer appendix is still being attached to the change record, so the current checklist doesn't reflect these requirements yet. We need to make sure the validation plan accounts for this before commissioning proceeds.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share my safety walkdown findings. The V-12 access-door interlock must be tested through exactly 6 open-and-trip cycles before commissioning, with the results recorded in an interlock test record. The permit draft is currently waiting for my walkdown notes and does not yet contain that required test count, so we need to make sure this gets incorporated before the work order is approved.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Ensure the fit-up check findings (Cell 7 bracket alignment, 4 hours, 3 electrical isolation points) from the weekend commissioning file are incorporated into the work-order summary before approval.
Ensure the quality checklist is revised to include 30 signed reference samples and challenge testing on 100 consecutive production pieces once the customer appendix is attached to the change record.
Ensure the permit draft is updated with the 6 open-and-trip interlock test cycles and the interlock test record requirement before the work order is approved.
No production release decisions will be made using the V-12 station until both commissioning and validation are fully completed per the requirements above.
